name: Kindly Hookback
description: Open the second course by settling into a balanced stance with the halberd held ready across the body.

name: Heaveswat
description: Hew the axe blade down and across at the opponent's shoulder with the turn of the hips behind it.

name: Axeheel Hammerfall
description: Lunge with a long step and prick the spear point at the gap between breastplate and arm.

name: Armored Socketring
description: Slide the rear hand up the haft to meet a blow with the strongest part of the shaft and turn it.

name: Langetslap
description: Carry a missed chop on through a full flat arc with qi in the edge to catch anyone stepping in.

name: Ruthless Snatch
description: Drive the spear point forward with qi running along the shaft so the thrust pierces light armor.

name: Cooling Langet
description: Hold the halberd with weight even between the heavy axe head and the point so either may strike.

name: Haftslap
description: Let the weight of the axe head fall straight down onto the opponent's guard to batter it open.

name: Brisk Hookback
description: Jab the spear point at the opponent's chest to check an advance and hold them at reach.

name: Cramping Haft
description: Draw the beak back over the opponent's forearm to pull their weapon hand out of position.

name: Guarding Crownspike
description: Brace the haft against the forearm and the hip to stop a heavy cut without being driven back.

name: Raw Axefall
description: Feint a chop high then turn the halberd in the hands and stab with the spike beneath the guard.

name: Heavethwack
description: Pull a thrust back past the body and reverse it into an axe cut that lands as the guard rises.

name: Patient Beak
description: Stand with the halberd held at the very end of the haft to give the axe blade its longest reach.

name: Rude Heave
description: Hew from full extension so the axe blade lands at the tip of the arc where it bites hardest.

name: Beakscorer
description: Press the spear point forward at full extension and hold it against the opponent's chest to stop them.

name: Guarding Haft
description: Sweep the long shaft across the front to push aside any weapon that comes inside reach.

name: Dragstalk
description: Take long gliding paces forward to keep the opponent at the edge of the halberd's reach.

name: Spikeprop
description: Hook the beak at the opponent's leading knee at the end of reach to check their advance.

name: Heaveflog
description: Throw the whole body forward behind a qi-loaded axe chop that reaches a full pace farther than expected.

name: Ducking Spikefall
description: Glide back to the safe distance at once after an overreach with qi lightening both feet.

name: Patient Crownspike
description: Set the stance so the hook the haft and the heel each have a ready line to the opponent.

name: Clutching Heave
description: Hook the beak over the opponent's shoulder and pull to drag them off balance toward the haft.

name: Spikethwack
description: Spin the halberd and strike with the heel of the haft against the opponent's ribs or hand.

name: Fierce Spikefall
description: Answer a missed cut by stabbing the spike backward under the arm toward an opponent who has closed in.

name: Hum Tailstop
description: Slide the haft along the incoming blade to carry it past the body and open a counter.

name: Grit Heave
description: Retreat while holding the hooked head forward so any follower runs onto the beak.

name: Draught Snatch
description: Hook the leg to trip the opponent and then cleave down with the axe blade as they fall.

name: Stampheave
description: Pin the opponent's weapon against the ground with the beak and the heel of the haft together.

name: Staticsnatch
description: Hook the beak under the arm and lever on the haft to throw the opponent over the hip.

name: Sound Langet
description: Carry the halberd at the slope while marching so it may drop into guard in a single motion.

name: Stern Axeblade
description: Chop straight down from the slope in a short drilled cut that fits a tight ranks space.

name: Bold Spike
description: Thrust straight out past the shoulder of the soldier in front without breaking the line.

name: Haftprop
description: Brace the haft against the ground and the shoulder to meet a rush with a firm hold.

name: Clutching Beak
description: Snatch at a spear shaft or a belt with the beak and tear the foe out of the front line.

name: Spike Glide
description: Press forward one pace with the line while keeping the halberd points aligned with the neighbors.

name: Ruthless Tailstop
description: Reverse the halberd and stab with the butt spike at a foe who has come under the head.

name: Stalwart Socketring
description: Set the butt against the ground and angle the head up so a charging foe is stopped and pinned.

name: Cinderheave
description: Cleave with qi in the edge so the blow clears the space ahead of two ranks at once.
first_area: Chapter 005 — The House With No Walls (Ref: 1.1.1.005)

name: Levering Hookpull
description: Hook a rider or a high-set foe and haul them down so the line can finish them.

name: Quickening Hookback
description: Seat the breath low and let a thread of qi settle along the whole length of the shaft.

name: Stern Hookpull
description: Hew with the qi thread running into the axe edge so the cut lands with extra bite.

name: Snatchscorer
description: Prick with the qi thread running to the point so the thrust slips through thin cloth and leather.

name: Axeheel Prop
description: Let the shaft ring against a blow and send qi down it so the blow is shed along the wood.

name: Lithe Socketring
description: Hop lightly with qi in the legs to change facing without losing the line of the shaft.

name: Beak Swat
description: Send a pulse of qi down the haft into the axe blade at the moment of impact for a heavier blow.

name: Resolute Langet
description: Spin the halberd so a ring of qi along the shaft turns aside blows aimed at the body.

name: Alert Langet
description: Stand with the beak forward and low to meet a spear point and catch the shaft behind it.

name: Sprout Socketring
description: Stand with the haft high and the head back so a sword must pass the shaft to reach the body.

name: Sprighaft
description: Press the beak down over a spear shaft to pin it to the ground and close in.

name: Beakthwack
description: Cut the axe blade down at the sword arm before the blade can come around into reach.

name: Honedbeak
description: Stab the spear point out to stop a swordsman at the end of the halberd's reach.

name: Langetstalk
description: Step back out of sword range then forward again as the swing ends to strike first.

name: Axefall Buckle
description: Trap a spear shaft between the beak and the haft and pull the spearman off balance.

name: Hookpull Carapace
description: Slide along a sword blade into a hook of the beak behind the guard and wrench the weapon free.

name: Genial Haft
description: Carry the halberd with the beak forward so it may peck or rake at once from the carry.

name: Snatchswat
description: Peck the sharpened beak downward at a helmet or a pauldron to crack the plate.

name: Heavescorer
description: Shear the axe edge across a limb and pull back so the beak rakes after it.

name: Spike Buckle
description: Slip the beak under an incoming weapon and lift to turn it away from the body.

name: Hungry Axeheel
description: Drive the qi-hardened beak into the seam between plates where mail or leather shows beneath.

name: Rushing Drag
description: Rake the beak down the opponent's shield face or arm and tear the cover away.

name: Tenderhearted Hookback
description: Stand shoulder to shoulder at drill spacing with the halberd head level with those on either side.

name: Ember Spikefall
description: Chop from the shoulder in unison with the line so the blows land together on the front rank.

name: Shard Axefall
description: Thrust past the neighbor's shoulder in unison so the points form a single bristling front.

name: Hum Crownspike
description: Roll the haft outward to knock a blow away from the neighbor as well as oneself.

name: Binding Axeblade
description: Hook an enemy weapon from a neighbor's flank so the whole line may step through the opening.

name: Snatchhurdle
description: Pace back in time with the line so no gap opens as the rank gives ground.

name: Ember Drag
description: Sweep the axe blade out in step with the march to clear the front of anyone who closes.

name: Comet Hookpull
description: Lean the shoulder into the thrust and drive the spike through a line of shields.

name: Fleet Tailstop
description: Step quickly sideways into a gap left in the line and keep the halberd head in place.

name: Genial Tailstop
description: Begin each sequence from the same ready hold so the chain of moves starts clean.

name: Clayspike
description: Open the sequence with a straight chop from the ready hold at the opponent's guard.

name: Brass Spikefall
description: Follow the opening chop with a straight thrust of the point at the chest.

name: Poise Beak
description: Turn the haft over in the hands to parry between the strikes of a sequence.

name: Hum Spike
description: Tap the beak against the opponent's weapon at the end of a strike to spoil the reply.

name: Heaveglide
description: Close the sequence with a step back to the ready hold and a clear line of retreat.

name: Honed Snatch
description: Chain three cleaves from alternating sides with qi refreshing the edge so each blow lands as hard as the first.

name: Honed Spikefall
description: Thrust and then draw the beak back across the same line to snatch the weapon the thrust has pinned.

name: Brawnhaft
description: Draw the halberd from its sacking wrap in one pull as the first blow begins and let the wrap fall behind.

name: Keen Axeblade
description: Hew down at the shoulder of a guard walking beside the team before he can turn from the wheel.

name: Honed Spike
description: Thrust the spike over a wagon's tailboard at the driver or the guard riding beside him.

name: Dragbuckle
description: Hook the beak into the harness traces and pull so the team slews and the wagon stops.

name: Rubble Axefall
description: Cleave across the width of the road with qi in the edge so the head of a marching file is cut apart.

name: Stalling Haft
description: Drive the haft through the spokes of a wheel and heave so the wagon can neither roll nor turn.
first_area: Chapter 005 — The House With No Walls (Ref: 1.1.1.005)

name: Patient Tailstop
description: Crouch low in a ditch with the halberd held short so the head cannot be seen above the grass.

name: Haftglide
description: Slip along the flank of a wagon in short quick steps with the wheel kept between oneself and the guards.

name: Rushing Axeblade
description: Burst from the hedge in one stride and cut at the nearest guard's arm before he sees the head.

name: Beakhasp
description: Hook the beak over a bridle or a belt and twist so the guard is turned off his footing.

name: Wild Axeheel
description: Vault the wagon rail with qi in the legs and cut down at the guard standing on the far side.

name: Cruel Crownspike
description: Rip the cargo cover with the spike and fling it over the guard's head so he cannot see the next blow.
